axes: Unity metres. Authored in Unity axes; Blender = (-x, -z, y); FBX export as the harbour (-Z forward, Y up, bake_space_transform). Each FBX object is at the origin with an identity transform. Every model is a LOCAL model: building origin = centre of its footprint at ground level, front/door = +z.

encoding.uv1: Layer: (palette slot, texture layer) on every corner (no uv1.z in the FBX: the material gives the mapping)
encoding.colour: Col: 0.5 x baked AO (per-vertex ray-cast bake per model, 1 m)

material_default: M_Toon_Base (every model; no triplanar objects here)
glass_and_water: *_Glass objects want a transparent glass material, *_Water objects a water material (the toon shader is meant for everything else). A tank is three FBX files with the same origin: Village_X (body), Village_X_Glass, Village_X_Water; place all three at the same transform.

pad.note: worn-earth apron owned by the model; the Unity builder puts the building origin on the lot centre at ground height

footprint.origin: centre of the pad at ground level (y 0); the extents are the whole mesh at yaw 0 (roof overhangs, awnings, props included)

pad.note: worn-earth apron owned by the model; the Unity builder puts the building origin on the lot centre at ground height

fbx.placement: origin on the lot centre, yaw = lot yaw (or lot yaw + 180); y = the lot ground height

fbx.name: Village_DisplayTank
fbx.note: Aquarium display tank body (cabinet, frame, hood, gravel, rocks, kelp, a toy lighthouse). Glass and water are separate objects.

swim_volume.note: inside the water volume; keep fish centres 0.05 m inside

fbx.placement_note: origin = base centre on the floor, front +z; footprint 2.7 x 1.0 m, height 2.08 m

fbx.name: Village_DisplayTank_Glass
fbx.note: Glass panes of the display tank: put the glass material on this object.

fbx.name: Village_DisplayTank_Water
fbx.note: Water volume of the display tank: put the water material on this object.

fbx.name: Village_BreedingTank
fbx.note: Breeding tank body: two compartments, a pump, air lines, a heater, a breeding trap.

swim_volume.note: two compartments split at x = 0 (A west, B east): keep a pair per side

fbx.placement_note: origin = base centre on the floor, front +z; footprint 1.9 x 0.9 m (+0.4 m pump on the east side), height 1.72 m

fbx.name: Village_BreedingTank_Glass
fbx.note: Glass of the breeding tank (outer panes and the centre divider).

fbx.name: Village_BreedingTank_Water
fbx.note: Water volumes of the breeding tank (one box per compartment).

fbx.name: Village_TouchPool
fbx.note: Touch pool: a low stone basin with a rock rim, seaweed, starfish and a sign. The water is a separate object.
fbx.placement_note: origin = base centre on the ground, front +z; basin 3.0 x 1.8 m, rim 0.62 m, water surface at y 0.5; the sign post stands 0.5 m east of the basin

fbx.name: Village_TouchPool_Water
fbx.note: Water surface of the touch pool: put the water material on this object.
